name: Hinott's Assistance
summary: At Tarren Mill, a Horde rogue seeks Serge Hinott's help against Zanzil's poison. The Forsaken chemist studies the toxin and prepares a cure.

sections.title: A Toxic Masterpiece
sections.body: After a Barrens assignment leaves you suffering from a toxin that clouds the mind, you are sent north to Tarren Mill. Serge Hinott, a Forsaken chemist, studies the poison made by Zanzil, a jungle troll exile. Hinott cares little about the troll's identity or kin. He admires the brew's vicious effect and wants to understand how it works before making an antidote.

sections.title: The Antidote and the Trade
sections.body: Hinott needs time to isolate the poison's active agents. His finished remedy halts the creeping madness, though he says its lingering stench remains. Once the venom no longer weakens you, Hinott shares what he learned from Zanzil's work. You can use that knowledge to prepare tactical poisons of your own.

faq.answer: Wait a few moments in Tarren Mill while Serge Hinott prepares the antidote. When it is ready, speak with him to take the cure and clear Zanzil's poison.
Serge Hinott is a Forsaken alchemist and poison expert at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He helps Horde rogues cure unusual afflictions and learn to prepare venom.

faq.q: Why is Serge Hinott impressed by the poison?
faq.answer: Hinott admires the craft in Zanzil's formula, which combines creeping madness with physical weakness. Though he works to stop its effects, he praises the skill behind the destructive brew.

faq.q: What is the lingering smell Hinott mentions?
faq.answer: Zanzil's mixture leaves a pungent, sickly odor that lingers in the victim's pores. Hinott's antidote halts the poison and clears the mind, but the stench remains for a time.

faq.q: What is the reward for completing this quest?
faq.answer: The cure clears the lasting affliction from your rogue training and opens the way to learning Rogue Poisons, so you can brew debilitating coatings.

faq.q: Where is this quest turned in?
faq.answer: You meet Serge Hinott at Tarren Mill in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills, where he begins and completes the work.

angles.text: As a rogue, you are cured of the affliction from your initiation and gain the knowledge to make tactical poisons.
As a member of the Horde, you can learn from Forsaken alchemy as it turns jungle troll toxins into field knowledge.
As an Undead, you see Apothecary Hinott's detached admiration for poison made with skill, whatever its origin.
